about: #80's first held-out set: written by a sub-agent from the decided meanings only, and run once after the grammar was frozen. Leaked: the prompt suggested phrasings the grammar was built for. Created on Friday 2026-10-02 at 10:00, local time, unless 'created' says otherwise. Expectations as decided in #89-#92: phrases that were 'unclear' in #80 and have a meaning now say so in 'basis'. Format in tests/unit/core/test_meanings.py.
